_about: Limits for the orchestrate skill on the Mac mini (8 cores, 8 GB), shared with every session on the machine: see .claude/skills/orchestrate/scripts/orchestrate.py DEFAULTS (#271).

_heavy._note: Run each of these only as: python3 .claude/skills/orchestrate/scripts/orchestrate.py heavy --label "<piece>" -- <command>
_heavy.server tests: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml run --rm tests  (then: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down)
_heavy.iOS simulator build: cd apps/ios && ~/GitHub/mkplus/Scripts/with-simulator.sh xcodebuild -project WalletWeather.xcodeproj -scheme WalletWeather -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone Duo' build
_heavy.TestFlight upload: apps/ios/Scripts/testflight.sh  (only when asked, after a full test run passed)

_extra_locks: mkplus's with-simulator.sh holds /tmp/pillowplayer-simulator.lock for every simulator command on this Mac, so a simulator run in any project counts as the heavy job.
